title: Coherence and lower boundedness of derived internal Hom on a locally Noetherian algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Assume $X$ is locally Noetherian, meaning that it admits a surjective etale atlas by schemes having affine open covers with Noetherian coordinate rings [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Use module sheaves on the small etale site with its structure sheaf $\mathcal O_X$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A module sheaf is coherent if on each Noetherian affine etale chart $\operatorname{Spec}R\to X$ it is associated to a finitely generated $R$-module $N$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; the associated etale sheaf has value $B\otimes_RN$ on each affine etale chart $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}R$. Let $K,L\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ have coherent cohomology, with $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for all sufficiently large $i$ and $\mathcal H^i(L)=0$ for all sufficiently negative $i$. Then $R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom] has coherent cohomology and its cohomology vanishes in all sufficiently negative degrees.

proof.text: Choose global bounds $u,v$ with $\mathcal H^i(K)=0$ for $i>u$ and $\mathcal H^i(L)=0$ for $i<v$. Fix any Noetherian affine etale chart $j:U=\operatorname{Spec}A\to X$. By [def-trf-algebraic-space] its localized ringed site is $U_{\mathrm{et}}$ with its structure sheaf. Restriction is exact by [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], so $K|_U,L|_U$ retain these cohomological bounds and have coherent, hence quasi-coherent, cohomology. By [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-module-realization] write them as $a_A(E),a_A(F)$ for $E,F\in D(A)$. The cohomology and section identifications there show that $H^i(E),H^i(F)$ are finite $A$-modules and vanish respectively for $i>u$ and $i<v$: the coherence convention on this affine chart identifies each cohomology sheaf with $a_A$ of a finite module, recovered by sections.

Put $T=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_X}(K,L)$. The slice comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction] and the affine comparison of [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-hom-realization] give, in the derived category of $U_{\mathrm{et}}$,
$$T|_U\cong R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_U}(a_A(E),a_A(F))\cong a_A(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(E,F)).$$
The latter applies because $A$ is Noetherian, $E$ has finite cohomology and is bounded above, and $F$ is bounded below.

Apply [lem-trf-bounded-above-coherent-rhom] to $A,E,F$ with these same integers $u,v$. Every $H^r(R\operatorname{Hom}_A(E,F))$ is finite and is zero for $r<v-u$. Exact restriction and the cohomology comparison of [lem-sfb-affine-etale-derived-module-realization] therefore identify $\mathcal H^r(T)|_U$ with its associated etale sheaf. Since $U$ was any Noetherian affine etale chart, this proves coherence in exactly the convention of the statement.

The same bound $v-u$ works on all the charts. They cover $X$ by local Noetherianness. For $r<v-u$ a section of $\mathcal H^r(T)$ on any etale object restricts to zero on the covering obtained by pulling back an affine etale atlas and refining by affine opens. The separatedness axiom for a sheaf makes that section zero. Thus $\mathcal H^r(T)=0$ globally, proving the required lower boundedness. This also covers the empty space, where every sheaf is zero.

lean.statement: theorem coherent_derivedInternalHom {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (hln : ∀ T : X.EtaleSite, IsLocallyNoetherian (X.etaleForget.obj T)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} X.SmallModules] (K L : X.DerivedModules) (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj K).IsFinitePresentation) (hL : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj L).IsFinitePresentation) (hKbounded : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, a < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj K)) (hLbounded : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < b → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj L)) : (∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj (X.derivedHom.obj (op K, L))).IsFinitePresentation) ∧ (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < c → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.SmallModules i).obj (X.derivedHom.obj (op K, L))))
